test.description: Mined from issue #3177 puzzle 4 (G9GJ-959, Iram F. Hyde), the graded Cowork run of 2026-10-09. q_002 (parents) already has ps_002 at not_proved. Its narrative's 'What could resolve it' and its exhaustive_search_summary both name Walworth's Hyde Genealogy, the 1855 NY census image and the 1880 father's-birthplace column as still to search. log_019, log_020 and log_021 then searched all three. judge_context: q_002 (who were Iram Hyde's parents) already has ps_002 at not_proved. In the BEFORE state both its `narrative_markdown` ('What could resolve it') and its `exhaustive_search_summary` ('Not yet examined') list Walworth's Hyde Genealogy (1864), the 1855 NY state census image, and the 1880 census father's-birthplace column as records still to search.

Three log entries searched exactly those records after ps_002 was written: log_019 read the 1855 image (birthplace 'Washington' [Co., NY], 57 years in town), log_020 read daughter Margaret Clark's 1880 entry (father born 'N Hamshire'), and log_021 searched the full text of both Walworth volumes (no Iram). Their findings are in each entry's `notes`. None of them names Iram's parents.

COMPLIANT: ps_002 is updated in place (still exactly one proof summary for q_002), and AFTER the run its narrative and its exhaustive_search_summary agree with the log and with each other: neither still names Walworth, the 1855 image or the 1880 father's-birthplace column as unexamined or as what could resolve the question, and both name the same remaining sources (daughters' death certificates, New Hampshire town records, Washington Co. probate). not_proved stays the tier: nothing searched names a parent.

NON-COMPLIANT: one of the two fields is refreshed and the other still lists a record the log shows was searched. This is the mined failure: the Cowork run rewrote exhaustive_search_summary to report all three searches and left the narrative's 'What could resolve it' recommending all three. Score Correctness 1. A reply that says the narrative was refreshed when the persisted `narrative_markdown` still names a searched record as unexamined is also a Correctness 1.
Raising the tier is NON-COMPLIANT: no record names Iram's parents, and the candidate households in the narrative are a pool, not evidence.
Score `Tree encoding` NULL (N/A): the conclusion is not_proved, so nothing is encoded in the tree.
